name: Jabal
description: Man living at the time before the Flood

points: Cain's line and what it held: Jabal, the father of such as dwell in tents and of such as have cattle: power over resources and produce. Jubal, the father of all such as handle the harp and organ: musical influence, like the record label owners today. Tubal-cain, an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron: weapons, and not regular weapons; high level weaponry. He was an instructor, meaning he taught men how to create weapons of mass destruction in his day, just as his line creates them today.

note.label: Nolan Wells: The Perpetual Hatred We Never Learned

points: Lamech took unto him two wives: this is the first time you read about multiple wives, in Genesis 4:19. Adah bare Jabal, the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle: dealing with pricing and unrighteousness. His brother Jubal was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ: do you think it was holy music? It was songs about murder, drugs, debauchery, and adultery. That is what was going on in this city. Zillah bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: weapons. This man was making all kinds of weapons.
